regions.text: Singapore raised its forecast for GDP, or total economic output, to around 6%.

regions.text: Newfoundland and Labrador forecasts a budget surplus from $1-billion in extra oil revenue.

regions.text: UK cyber incidents reported in October 2026 were 52% above the previous high in May 2025.

cover_dek: Nvidia shares jumped after its board unanimously reinstated chief Jensen Huang.
big_headline: Nvidia reinstates chief executive Jensen Huang at the urging of Donald Trump.
big_body: The board unanimously reinstated Jensen Huang as chief executive officer, or CEO. Shares jumped more than 30% at the start of US trading on Monday.
pol_body: US central banker John Williams says higher interest rates are likely over time to address inflation, or price rises. He is confident it will near 2% in 2027.
biz_body: Gold, a precious metal, broke above $3,600. The Nasdaq, a U.S. stock index, rose 6.5%. Indices fell 7% to 10% last week.
up_body: Mitek Systems set its Q4FY26 results earnings call, a meeting to report financial performance, for December 10, 2026.
